node.statement: By def-stochastic, row-stochastic Q is positive and unital on l_inf^n. It is completely positive because, for every m and every positive F=(F_j) in M_m(l_inf^n), (Q^{(m)}F)_i=sum_j q_ij F_j is a nonnegative linear combination of positive matrices. Diagonal extraction D is UCP because each amplified coordinate is the compression [a_rs]->[a_rs(i,i)], and diagonal inclusion J is a unital *-homomorphism, hence UCP. Therefore Phi=JQD is UCP and completely contractive; D J=I by entrywise inspection, range(Phi) is diagonal, and D Phi=D J Q D=Q D.
